TEXT.English: Catherine's Noble Assembly turns the courthouse into a provincial arm of imperial rule, tying elite privilege, local administration, court culture, and surveillance together under the crown.
Imperial Russia unique Courthouse replacement. Keeps the normal maintenance reduction and adds 1 Gold, 1 Culture, 2 Espionage, 1 Artist slot, and 1 Spy slot.

The Black Sea Hussar represents Catherine's fast southern campaigning against the Ottomans and across the steppe, where mobility, scouting, and sustained mounted pressure mattered more than heavy battlefield staying power.
Imperial Russia unique Cuirassier replacement. Moves 1 tile faster, costs 115, needs Horse but not Iron, and starts with Flanking I and Sentry.
